item: Gate item 47: selftests.json and merge-diag.json sit outside the member deadline, as a stated limit with the profile
summary: Both are long members that do not scale with the corpus; WAL's cold figures sit inside the warm spread (7.2 to 11.4 s and 5.6 to 8.3 s), so they are not a cold cost. selftests.json: simplemma's one-time dictionary load is 9.12, 7.14 and 7.27 s of keyword-selftest's 11.58, 8.58 and 8.73 s (three fresh processes on the 4-vCPU lab sandbox, not the CI runner, unprofiled; 0.02 s on a second call), so the cost is the lemma cold load, fixed in the keyword lane. merge-diag.json: 8.42, 5.90 and 5.86 s unprofiled (three fresh processes, same sandbox); the split (6.19 s of 9.19 s in sqlcipher3 execute, the probe's own synthetic INSERT..SELECT, whose time is the measurement) was taken under cProfile, which costs 10 to 30 percent here, and is a proportion under cProfile, not a wall, and the unprofiled split was not taken. RC2's figures are plain-store fresh-process; WAL's 8.49 s and 7.28 s are the encrypted 9.9 M-row store and are labelled as WAL's.
